## [CN]项目专属 Skill
## [EN]Project skills

| Skill | 中文 | English |
|:---|:---|:---|
| `cyl-new-project` | 创建新 App 或新 Demo：集成方式、子库、版本、入口代码。今后所有新 Demo 都必须遵循它 | Create a new app or demo: integration, subspec, versions, entry code. Every new demo must follow it |
| `cyl-plus-button` | PlusButton 的规则与限制。例如强制标题对齐时，不建议 PlusButton 不设置标题 | The plus button's rules and limits. For example, with forced title alignment, a plus button without a title is not recommended |
| `cyl-xcode-compat` | Xcode 与 iOS 版本兼容性、工程格式 | Xcode and iOS compatibility, project format |
| `cyl-tab-animation` | Lottie、PAG、Rive 动画图标 | Lottie, PAG and Rive tab icons |
| `cyl-theme` | 换肤与原地更新 Tab | Themes and in-place tab updates |
| `cyl-api-map` | 功能与文档的对照表 | Which document holds which feature |
| `cyl-docs` | 文档规则 | Documentation rules |
| `cyl-verify` | 构建、测试、模拟器与常见问题 | Build, test, simulator and common failures |

| 中文 | English |
|:---|:---|
| 每次新增 API、功能、限制或 Demo，都要在同一次改动中更新 `docs/`、README 和相关的 `cyl-*` skill。`python3 scripts/sync-agent-skills.py --check` 会在文档或 Demo 未写入 skill 时失败，`Docs navigation` workflow 会运行它。 | Every new API, feature, limit or demo updates `docs/`, the README and the `cyl-*` skills it affects, in the same change. `python3 scripts/sync-agent-skills.py --check` fails when a document or a demo is missing from the skills, and the `Docs navigation` workflow runs it. |

## [CN]第三方 Skill
## [EN]Third-party skills

| 中文 | English |
|:---|:---|
| 清单是 `.agents/skills.json`（固定 commit），`.agents/skills.lock.json` 记录哈希，每个 skill 附带上游许可证 `UPSTREAM-LICENSE`。不要手改这些 skill：修改清单后运行 `python3 scripts/sync-agent-skills.py`；升级用 `--update <owner/repo>`。 | The manifest is `.agents/skills.json` (pinned commits), `.agents/skills.lock.json` records the hashes, and each skill carries its upstream license as `UPSTREAM-LICENSE`. Do not edit these skills by hand: change the manifest and run `python3 scripts/sync-agent-skills.py`; upgrade with `--update <owner/repo>`. |
| 只拷贝与本库相关的 skill，因为每个 skill 的描述都会占用 AI 工具每次对话的上下文。要增加更多，把名字加入清单即可。 | Only the skills relevant to this library are copied, because each skill's description takes context in every session of an AI tool. To add more, add their names to the manifest. |

| 来源 / Source | 可用 / Available | 已加入 / Added | 许可证 / License | 用途 / For |
|:---|:---|:---|:---|:---|
| [dpearson2699/swift-ios-skills](https://github.com/dpearson2699/swift-ios-skills) | 86 | 16 | PolyForm Perimeter 1.0.0 | SwiftUI、Liquid Glass、Swift、无障碍、本地化、调试 / SwiftUI, Liquid Glass, Swift, accessibility, localization, debugging |
| [conorluddy/ios-simulator-skill](https://github.com/conorluddy/ios-simulator-skill) | 1 | 1 | MIT | 模拟器自动化 / Simulator automation |
| [rshankras/claude-code-apple-skills](https://github.com/rshankras/claude-code-apple-skills) | 184 | 12 | MIT | UI 审查、TDD、迁移、真机运行 / UI review, TDD, migration, running on a device |
| [droidrun/mobile-harness](https://github.com/droidrun/mobile-harness) | 1 | 1（不含图片 / without images） | MIT | 设备控制；需要自行安装 `mobilerun-core` / Device control; `mobilerun-core` must be installed first |
| [Prisma-Labs-Dev/apple-skills](https://github.com/Prisma-Labs-Dev/apple-skills) | 34 | 6 | MIT | UIKit、Core Animation、Core Haptics、XCUITest、HIG 参考 / UIKit, Core Animation, Core Haptics, XCUITest and HIG references |
| [JordanCoin/ios-skills-collection](https://github.com/JordanCoin/ios-skills-collection)（GitHub 搜索 / GitHub search） | 206 | 6 | MIT | UIKit 布局与模式、UIKit 无障碍、Xcode 工程分析、XcodeBuildMCP / UIKit layout and patterns, UIKit accessibility, Xcode project analysis, XcodeBuildMCP |

| 中文 | English |
|:---|:---|
| 第三方 skill 面向现代 Swift，而本库是 Objective-C，并提供 Swift 5 接口；发生冲突时以 AGENTS.md 和 `cyl-*` skill 为准。 | Third-party skills target modern Swift, while this library is Objective-C with a Swift 5 API. Where they conflict, AGENTS.md and the `cyl-*` skills win. |
| `dpearson2699/swift-ios-skills` 的许可证不是开源许可证：不得用于与其竞争的产品；再分发时必须保留许可证与声明。 | The license of `dpearson2699/swift-ios-skills` is not an open source license: it may not be used for a competing product, and redistribution must keep the license and notice. |
| 未加入：[creeveliu/ios-skills](https://github.com/creeveliu/ios-skills)（含 Objective-C 与 UIKit，内容相关）和 [199-biotechnologies/swiftui-claude-skills](https://github.com/199-biotechnologies/swiftui-claude-skills) 没有许可证，不能拷贝；其他搜索结果与本库无关，或者是上述仓库的副本。 | Not added: [creeveliu/ios-skills](https://github.com/creeveliu/ios-skills) (relevant, with Objective-C and UIKit) and [199-biotechnologies/swiftui-claude-skills](https://github.com/199-biotechnologies/swiftui-claude-skills) have no license, so they cannot be copied. The other search results are unrelated to this library, or copies of the repositories above. |
